name: Special South Gate City Council
minutes_text:
CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  NOVEMBER  25, 2025

CALL  TO ORDER  Maria  Davila,  Mayor  called  a Special  City  Council  Meeting  to order  at
  5:31 p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Vice  Mayor  Joshua  Barron,  Council  Member  Maria
  del Pilar  Avalos,  Council  Member  Gil  Hurtado  and Council  Member  Al
  Rios;  City  Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, City  Manager  Rob  Houston,  City
  Attorney  Raul  F. Salinas

I
CERTIRICATES  OF

APPRECIATION  The City  Council  issued  Certificates  of Appreciation  to the South  Gate
  Police  Department's  CitizenAcademy.

2
PERSONNEL  RECRUITMENT

& SELECTION  The City  Council  unanimously  received  and filed  the list of new  and
  promoted  'full-time  employees  hired  or promoted  during  October  2025.

CLOSED  SESSION  The Council  Members  recessed  into  Closed  Session  at 5:56  p.m.  and
  reconvened  at 6:39  p.m.  with  all Members  of Council  present.  City
  Attorney  Salinas  reported  the following:

  1.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LEGAL  COUNSEL  - PENDING
  LITIGATION
  Pursuant  to Government  Code  Section  54956.9(a),
  54954.9(b)(3)(C),  54956.9(d)(1)(4)

  a. Esteban  Hernandez  v. City  of South  Gate,  et al.
  b. Ernmanuel  Carrillo  v. City  of South  Gate
  c. Jane Doe 1, and Jane Doe  2 v. City  of South  Gate,  et al.
  d. Bertha  Iniguez  v. City  of South  Gate,  et al.

  Item  1(a)  involves  a claim  of someone  that tripped  and fell.  The  city
  received  an offer  to settle  and upon  receiving  a presentation  by the City
  Attorney's  Office,  the city  rejected  that  settlement  offer  on a motion  made
  by Council  Member  Hurtado  and seconded  by Vice  Mayor  Barron  and the
  vote  was  5-0.

  Item  1(b)  involves  a claim  of an individual  who  apparently  sustained  a
  seizure  at South  Gate  Park  and after  a presentation  by the City  Attorney,
  a motion  was made  by Council  Member  Hurtado  and seconded  by Vice
  Mayor  Barron  and on a vote  of 5-0,  City  Council  denied  the claim.
   SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF NOVEMBER  25, 2025

  Item  l(c)  is a complaint  in federal  court  alleged  against  the City  of South

  Gate and Police  Officer.  There's  a motion  alleging  civil  rights  violations

  and other claims.  There  was a presentation  made by outside  counsel  and

  on a motion  made by Council  Member  Hurtado  and seconded  by Mayor

  Davila,  and on a vote of 5-0, the City  Council  authorized  the defense  in

  that case,

  Item 1(d) is a lawsuit  recently  filed  against  the city alleging  a fall on a city

  sidewalk  the city and the property
  against  owners is  where  the sidewalk
  located. There was a presentation  made by the City Attorney  and upon
  completion  of that report, there was  a motion made by  Council  Member

  Avalos  and seconded  by Council  Member  Hurtado,  and on a vote of 5-0,
  City  Council  authorized  the defense  of that case.

 ADJOURNMENT  The meeting  unanimously  adjourned  at 6:45 p.m.

 PASSED  and APPROVED  on this 27"  day of January  2026.
